key_insight: Deep Pontryagin learning separates adjoint estimation from policy improvement to solve high-dimensional stochastic control problems with jump-diffusions.
engineering_relevance: The framework targets continuous-time decision systems with random fluctuations and abrupt jumps without repeatedly differentiating the objective through the full dynamics during policy updates.
method: Simulate trajectories under a fixed Markov control and backpropagate rewards to generate pathwise adjoint labels.
Regress adjoint labels onto the Markov state using supervised learning.
Update the control via pointwise Hamiltonian stationarity.
evidence_signal: The authors prove a discrete-time Pontryagin principle and continuous-time adjoint convergence, while numerical experiments illustrate accuracy, stability, and scalability without quantitative details in the abstract.
watch_item: Practical performance may depend on trajectory coverage and adjoint regression quality, especially when important jumps are rare.
paper_title: Deep Pontryagin Learning for Continuous-Time Stochastic Control with Jumps
